summary: Naktong River, Korea, A wrecked Russian T34/85 medium tank lies on the ruins of a bridge across the Naktong River. The tank and bridge were destroyed by US aircraft in the battle to stop the southward advance of North Korean forces. (Donor I. Robertson)
